englishTranslation: Fried spring rolls with shrimp and pork
atAGlance: Chả giò tôm thịt is fried spring rolls with shrimp and pork, usually with rice paper or wheat wrapper, herbs, lettuce, and nước chấm.
whatItIs: Chả giò tôm thịt are fried spring rolls filled with shrimp and pork, served crisp with lettuce, herbs, and nước chấm.
howToEnjoy: Wrap the crisp roll in lettuce or herbs, then dip lightly in nước chấm. The shrimp-pork filling is richer when the greens stay fresh.
howLocalsOrder: Order chả giò tôm thịt when you want the shrimp-and-pork fried roll. Ask for no chili in the nước chấm or extra lettuce before sharing.
worthKnowing: Tôm thịt means shrimp and pork, a useful filling phrase across rolls, dumplings, and noodle dishes.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần chả giò tôm thịt.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of fried spring rolls with shrimp and pork.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht fuhn chah yaw tom tit
